column3: NKJV has “provided for Him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “for them.”
Close to the Greek; “testing” is rendered “temptation.”
Close to the Greek; “perseverance” is rendered “patience.”
NKJV includes “by some, who said,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “it was reported to Him.”
NKJV reads “Gadarenes,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Gerasenes.”
NKJV has “who had demons for a long time. And he wore no clothes,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “who had demons; and for a long time he had not worn clothes.”
NKJV has “He had commanded,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the imperfect “He was commanding.”
